_source: Transcribed out of runs/C-9/cliffside_B/scenes/cliffside.tscn -- the live 2D route's own scene -- from the nodes between its '--- C-9 R-C9-42 far-layer landmarks (written by tools/place_landmarks_b.py) ---' markers. These are Sprite2D children of Layer_far_ruins, so they ride that layer's parallax rather than having one of their own, and they sit above its own sprite by z_index. They are not in parallax.json, which is why the first 3D background lacked them, and they are the violet skyline the plateau view shows.
